translationRepairs: Loyalty and revolt shifted unpredictably. Han Yong's suppression of Teng Gorge, Wang Shouren's pacification of Tianzhou, the campaigns of Shen Xiyi and Yu Dayou, and the successes of Yin Zhengmao and Weng Wanda barely sufficed to bring the territory back under survey and control.

Loyalty and revolt shifted unpredictably. Han Yong's suppression of Teng Gorge, Wang Shouren's pacification of Tianzhou, the campaigns of Shen Xiyi and Yu Dayou, and the successes of Yin Zhengmao and Weng Wanda barely sufficed to restore order.
In this campaign sequence 勘定 means pacify and settle, not cadastral survey; “restore order” matches 仅得勘定 without importing land-survey 勘.
Early in the Xining era the local leader Luo Shinan submitted;
Early in the Xining era the local leader Luo Shinian submitted;
The given name is 世念; 念 is nian, so Luo Shinian is the correct romanization, not Shinan.
At the beginning of Xining in Song, the native man Luo Shinan came to surrender;
At the beginning of Xining in Song, the native man Luo Shinian came to surrender;
The literal line repeats the same inversion of 念 as nan; Luo Shinian restores the given name.
during Chongning, Di and Na, two prefectures, were then established, with the Luo clan holding hereditary knowledge of Di Prefecture.
during Chongning, Di and Na, two prefectures, were then established, with the Luo clan hereditarily serving as prefects of Di Prefecture.
世知地州 uses 知 as the prefectural verb (知州), not “knowledge”; hereditary prefects of Di is the right sense.
Ming changed it to Tianzhou Prefecture, then soon restored it as a prefecture.
Ming changed it to Tianzhou Prefecture, then soon restored it as a zhou.
尋復為州 restores a zhou after the unit had been a fu; repeating “prefecture” erases the rank change. “Department (zhou)” is awkward beside this chapter’s usual rendering of 州.
Yuan was subordinate to Zhen'an Circuit.
Under the Yuan it was subordinate to Zhen'an Circuit.
元隸鎮安路 makes Guishun the subject in the Yuan period, not the Yuan dynasty itself subordinate to Zhen'an Circuit.
Under the Yuan it belonged to Tianzhou Circuit.
元屬田州路 means Sicheng belonged to Tianzhou Circuit in the Yuan, not that the Yuan belonged to the circuit.
Ming was subordinate to Si'en Prefecture.
Under the Ming it was subordinate to Si'en Prefecture.
明隸思恩府 likewise has Sicheng as subject under the Ming, not the Ming dynasty subordinate to Si'en.
Under the Yuan it belonged to Zhen'an Circuit.
元屬鎮安路 locates Xialei under Zhen'an Circuit in the Yuan; the dynasty is not the grammatical subject of 屬.
Yuan was subordinate to Tianzhou Circuit.
Under the Yuan it was subordinate to Tianzhou Circuit.
元隸田州路 refers to Xiangwu in the Yuan, not to the Yuan dynasty being subordinate to Tianzhou Circuit.
Under the Yuan it belonged to Tianzhou Circuit.
元屬田州路 has Dukang as subject in the Yuan; “Yuan belonged” inverts agent and place.
Under the Yuan it belonged to Tianzhou Circuit.
The same 元屬田州路 formula locates Guohua Native Prefecture, not the Yuan dynasty, under Tianzhou Circuit.
In the first year of Hongwu in Ming, Huang Weijun was made native officer; for losing the seal it was abolished as a dong, demoted to native inspector.
In the first year of Hongwu in Ming, Huang Weijun was made native officer; because the seal was lost, the post was reduced to a dong and demoted to native inspector.
廢為峒 means the office was reduced to a dong after the seal was lost, not that a dong was abolished.
Under the Han it belonged to Jiaozhi.
漢屬交阯 locates the Taiping region in Jiaozhi under the Han; the Han dynasty is not what “belonged to Jiaozhi.”
Taiping Prefecture lay northwest of Taiping fu.
Taiping zhou lay northwest of the prefectural seat.
太平州，在府西北 places the zhou northwest of the prefectural seat (府), not northwest of another place called Taiping Prefecture.
Early in the Ming the court promoted Zhao Ang to prefect.
Early in the Ming the court appointed Zhao Angsheng prefect.
以趙昂升為知州 appoints 趙昂升; 升 is part of the given name, not a promotion of a man named Zhao Ang.
At the beginning of Ming, Zhao Ang was promoted to prefect.
At the beginning of Ming, Zhao Angsheng was made prefect.
The literal line likewise drops 升 from 趙昂升 and misreads 以…為 as promotion rather than appointment.
In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and Jizu was executed.
In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi in Qing, submission was accepted, and Jizu was executed.
The preceding unit already records Zhao Yinchang’s murder, so “he submitted” wrongly makes the dead prefect the subject of 歸附.
Under the Yuan it belonged to Taiping Circuit.
元屬太平路 means the prefecture belonged to Taiping Circuit in the Yuan, not that the Yuan belonged to the circuit.
Under the Yuan it belonged to Taiping Circuit.
The same 元屬太平路 formula locates Luoyang Native County, not the Yuan dynasty, under Taiping Circuit.
Under the Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.
元屬思明路 has Siling as subject in the Yuan; “Yuan belonged to Siming Circuit” inverts the geography.
Song was subordinate to Taiping Stockade.
Under the Song it was subordinate to Taiping Stockade.
宋隸太平寨 locates Siming under Taiping Stockade in the Song, not the Song dynasty itself as subordinate.
The Ming downgraded the fu to a prefecture and moved the seat to Bojiang Stockade.
The Ming downgraded the fu to a zhou and moved the seat to Bojiang Stockade.
降府為州 is a rank reduction from fu to zhou; rendering both as “prefecture” collapses the change.
The succession reached Zhao Youjing, murdered by his younger half-brother Youtao.
The succession reached Zhao Youjing, murdered by his elder half-brother Youtao.
庶兄 is an elder brother by a secondary consort; “younger half-brother” reverses 兄.
The line passed to Zhao Youjing, who was killed by his younger half-brother Youtao.
The line passed to Zhao Youjing, who was killed by his elder half-brother Youtao.
The literal line repeats the same reversal of 庶兄; elder half-brother is required.
At the beginning of Hongwu in Ming, Li Sheng submitted within and Pingxiang Garrison was established.
At the beginning of Hongwu in Ming, Li Sheng submitted and came over, and Pingxiang Garrison was established.
內附 is submission and coming over to the court, not a spatial calque “submitted within.”
Though it briefly fell under Annam, it returned to Ming control and was placed under Taiping Prefecture.
At that time it again belonged to Annam, yet it returned to Ming control and was placed under Taiping Prefecture.
時又屬安南 states that it again belonged to Annam; “briefly” is not in the Chinese.
In Yongzheng 10 it was elevated to a regular prefecture.
In Yongzheng 10 it was changed to a regular prefect.
改知府 names the circulating prefect office; “elevated to a regular prefecture” invents a change of territorial rank not in the source.
At the beginning of Ming, it was abolished as a dong, with Xu Shangjue holding hereditary succession.
At the beginning of Ming, it was abolished and made a dong, with Xu Shangjue holding hereditary succession.
After Song 置州, 廢為峒 means the prefecture was abolished and made a dong, not abolished as a dong.
